req.title: Accept comma-separated status codes
req.statement: The system shall select one code at random when /status/<code> is called with a comma-separated list.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /status/<codes> with a comma-separated list shall select one code at random. Tests must verify: (1) positive - a valid comma-separated list returns one of the listed codes; (2) negative - an invalid code in the list returns 400; (3) boundary - a single-element 'list' (no comma) behaves as a direct code lookup; (4) weighted choices are parsed correctly; (5) the random selection covers all listed codes over repeated calls. The source shows the handler splits on ',' and calls weighted_choice, then status_code(). We must assert exact status codes and verify the set of possible outcomes matches exactly the input set.

tests.name: test_comma_separated_returns_one_of_listed_codes
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Collect all distinct status codes returned
expected: Every response status code is one of {200, 301, 404}
No status code outside {200, 301, 404} is ever returned
Over 60 trials all three codes appear at least once (probabilistic coverage)
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
seen = set()
for _ in range(60):
    r = client.get('/status/200,301,404')
    assert r.status_code in (200, 301, 404), f'Unexpected code: {r.status_code}'
    seen.add(r.status_code)
assert seen == {200, 301, 404}, f'Not all codes seen: {seen}'

def test_comma_separated_returns_one_of_listed_codes():
    client2 = app.test_client()
    seen2 = set()
    for _ in range(60):
        r = client2.get('/status/200,301,404')
        assert r.status_code in (200, 301, 404)
        seen2.add(r.status_code)
    assert seen2 == {200, 301, 404}

tests.name: test_single_code_no_comma_returns_exact_code
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /status/200 (no comma — boundary: list of exactly one element)
expected: The single-code path (no comma branch) is exercised
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_single_code_no_comma_returns_exact_code():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/status/200')
    assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200, got {r.status_code}'
    r2 = client.get('/status/404')
    assert r2.status_code == 404, f'Expected 404, got {r2.status_code}'
    r3 = client.get('/status/500')
    assert r3.status_code == 500, f'Expected 500, got {r3.status_code}'

tests.name: test_two_code_comma_list_returns_only_those_two
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: Both 200 and 500 appear at least once over 50 trials
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_two_code_comma_list_returns_only_those_two():
    client = app.test_client()
    seen = set()
    for _ in range(50):
        r = client.get('/status/200,500')
        assert r.status_code in (200, 500), f'Unexpected: {r.status_code}'
        seen.add(r.status_code)
    assert 200 in seen, 'Code 200 never returned'
    assert 500 in seen, 'Code 500 never returned'
    assert seen == {200, 500}, f'Extra codes seen: {seen}'

tests.name: test_weighted_comma_list_parses_and_returns_valid_code
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: Every response status code is exactly 200 or 500
No 400 error is returned (weights are valid floats)
200 appears more frequently than 500 due to weight 9 vs 1
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_weighted_comma_list_parses_and_returns_valid_code():
    client = app.test_client()
    seen = set()
    for _ in range(30):
        r = client.get('/status/200:9,500:1')
        assert r.status_code in (200, 500), f'Unexpected: {r.status_code}'
        seen.add(r.status_code)
    assert 200 in seen, '200 never returned despite weight 9'

from httpbin.core import app

def test_all_comma_codes_invalid_returns_400_not_500():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/status/xyz,abc')
    assert r.status_code == 400, f'Expected 400, got {r.status_code}'
    assert r.status_code != 500
    assert b'Invalid status code' in r.data
